# Docker Compose Mixin

[API index](index.md) | [Definition schema](schema.md)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `compose.base` |
| Source | `02_core/runtimes/yaml/definitions/docker.yaml` |
| Tags | docker, compose, abstract |

Variable surface for definitions that emit a `docker-compose.yml`.
Provides the `services`, `networks`, and `volumes` mappings plus the
`compose_yaml` rendered document (JSON form, which is valid YAML for
Docker Compose). This mixin is typically composed into `docker.base`
alongside `dockerfile.base`; it does not add run blocks of its own.

Children populate `services` (and optionally `networks`/`volumes`); the
`compose_yaml` template assembles them into a single document.
